name: External Agent Access to Front
description: The mechanism behind one claim: an agent can read and draft, only a human can send.

slices.name: Admin Creates a Connection
slices.note: Admin names the connection and picks its scopes. This is the only place scopes get set.

slices.name: Admin Revokes a Connection
slices.note: Immediate. Every call from that connection is denied from this point on.

slices.name: Agent Reads Conversation
slices.note: Requires read scope. No state change.

slices.name: Agent Drafts a Reply
slices.note: Requires draft scope. Produces a draft only, never a message the customer sees.

slices.name: Rep Reviews and Sends
slices.note: The only command that reaches the customer. No agent connection can issue it.

slices.name: Every Scoped Action Is Logged
slices.note: Admin sees connection, action, target, and time for every entry.
